[Add] Max amount of results in the getWatchlist films Array

Why is it necessary? (Bug fix, feature, improvements?)
 - Feature
How does the change address the issue?
 - In the options object there's a max prop that passes a number of items the user wants to get from the watchlist.

What side effects does this change have?
 - The other props (IMDBID & poster) were returning undefined if not specified so we check and add the default in case the user omits them while passing the max prop.

How does the change address the issue?

 - Added puppeteer-autoscroll-down package to use the  scrollPageTobottom method.
 - timeout promise added to the utils file to wait

[Add] New Scrapper class

Why is it necessary? (Bug fix, feature, improvements?)

   +launchBrowser -> start browser. Returns boolean
   +getPageContent -> searches url and returns the html content
   +closeBrowser -> closes the browser. Returns boolean
   + checkIfSelectorExists -> waits for the selector to appear and returns boolean
